# Vendored third-party files

## `w3c-wot-td-1.1-validation.schema.json`

The JSON Schema for validating W3C Web of Things (WoT) Thing Description 1.1
instances, from the W3C WoT Thing Description repository
(<https://github.com/w3c/wot-thing-description>, `validation/td-json-schema-validation.json`,
branch `REC1.1`). It is used by `tools/export_thing_descriptions.py` and its test to
validate the Thing Descriptions DoSync exports, without a network call.
